WebTransport - QUIC Communication

WebTransport bidirectional communication over QUIC with streams and datagrams. Low-latency transport with Rust WebAssembly optimization.

Features include low-latency transport, bidirectional streams, unreliable datagrams, built-in security, web-native API, and multiplexed connections over HTTP/3.

Perfect for real-time gaming, live video streaming, IoT communication, file transfer, and chat applications requiring reliable and unreliable data transmission.

Advanced connection visualization shows client-server communication with real-time statistics including RTT, bandwidth, stream counts, packet metrics, and reliability measurements.
